chunks: And it was said to al-Sadiq عليه السلام: “Indeed, Sharik rejects our testimony.” So he said:

key_terms.الصَّادِقِ: Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq عليه السلام
key_terms.شَرِيكًا: Sharik, the individual mentioned as rejecting their testimony

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about humiliating oneself when one's testimony is rejected?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام was told that Sharik was rejecting their testimony, and he responded by forbidding self-humiliation. It conveys an ethical directive to preserve one's dignity and not place oneself in situations of debasement.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3366 - It was said to Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as), "Sharik rejects our testimony.".
